meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-29 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: You took a full rest day and slept worse. That is the finding this morning, and it is the useful one. Score 73 on 6h 16m, lights out 23:46 and awake 06:44 — the shortest night on the board and 35 minutes under the 6h 51m average. The night before, after the heaviest lifting day of the block, you scored 79 on 6h 27m. So yesterday's zero-training day bought nothing. The problem is not load. It is fragmentation and bedtime. You woke six separate times against three the night before, 42 minutes awake in total, which is the most of any night here. Efficiency fell to 90% — the worst of the seven, and the only night this week under 91. Garmin's own read agrees: awake count and restlessness both came back fair. That is a night spent surfacing, not a night spent short. Bedtime is the other half. 23:08, 23:34, 23:39, 23:46 — four nights walking steadily later while your wake time stays pinned in the 06:12–06:44 band. You are not choosing shorter sleep, you are losing it 10 minutes at a time off the front. Monday's 22:20 is still the only lights-out this window that produced eight hours. The stage split is not the villain. Deep held at 1h 02m, 16% of the night, and it is the one component Garmin graded good — down from Thursday's exceptional 1h 44m but still ahead of Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday. REM took the hit at 51 minutes, 14%, second-thinnest of the seven, which is the standard cost of a short and broken night since REM is back-loaded. Light sleep filled 4h 23m. Autonomics softened but did not break. HRV came in at 36, three below both last night and the seven-night average, and level with the two weakest readings of the window. RHR ticked up one to 55, one over baseline. Overnight stress read 19 against 16 yesterday, and Body Battery charged 53 versus 58. Every one of those is a small step the wrong way, none is alarming, and together they read as one poor night rather than accumulating fatigue. Readiness lands at 71, fair — enough for a swim or a controlled lift, not for a session you would need to be sharp for. One lever tonight: lights out by 22:45. You have the wake time already; nothing else on this board needs fixing first.

hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Uzeo si potpuni dan odmora i spavao lošije. To je nalaz ovog jutra i to je onaj koristan. Ocjena 73 uz 6h 16m, svjetlo u 23:46, buđenje u 06:44 — najkraća noć na ploči i 35 minuta ispod prosjeka od 6h 51m. Noć prije, nakon najtežeg dana dizanja u bloku, imao si 79 uz 6h 27m. Dakle jučerašnji dan bez treninga nije kupio ništa. Problem nije opterećenje. Problem su isprekidanost i lijeganje. Budio si se šest puta, naspram tri prethodne noći, ukupno 42 minute budnosti, što je najviše od svih noći ovdje. Učinkovitost je pala na 90% — najlošija od sedam i jedina noć ovaj tjedan ispod 91. Garminova vlastita ocjena se slaže: broj buđenja i nemir oboje su ocijenjeni kao solidni. To je noć provedena u izranjanju, a ne noć provedena kratko. Lijeganje je druga polovica. 23:08, 23:34, 23:39, 23:46 — četiri noći koje ravnomjerno kasne, dok ti buđenje ostaje prikovano u pojasu 06:12–06:44. Ne biraš kraći san, gubiš ga po 10 minuta s prednje strane. Ponedjeljkovih 22:20 i dalje je jedino gašenje svjetla u ovom prozoru koje je proizvelo osam sati. Raspodjela faza nije krivac. Duboki san zadržao se na 1h 02m, 16% noći, i to je jedina komponenta koju je Garmin ocijenio dobrom — niže od četvrtkovih izvanrednih 1h 44m, ali i dalje ispred ponedjeljka, utorka i srijede. REM je platio cijenu sa 51 minutom, 14%, drugi najtanji udio od sedam, što je standardni trošak kratke i isprekidane noći jer REM dolazi pred kraj. Laki san ispunio je 4h 23m. Autonomika je popustila, ali nije pukla. HRV je 36, tri ispod i sinoćnjeg i sedmodnevnog prosjeka, u ravni s dva najslabija očitanja u prozoru. RHR je porastao za jedan na 55, jedan iznad osnovice. Noćni stres iznosio je 19 naspram jučerašnjih 16, a Body Battery napunio se 53 naspram 58. Svaki od tih pomaka je mali korak u krivom smjeru, nijedan nije zabrinjavajući, a zajedno se čitaju kao jedna loša noć, a ne kao nakupljeni umor. Spremnost je 71, solidna — dovoljno za plivanje ili kontrolirano dizanje, ne za trening u kojem bi trebao biti oštar. Jedna poluga večeras: svjetlo gasi do 22:45. Vrijeme buđenja već imaš; ništa drugo na ovoj ploči ne treba popraviti prije toga.
